id_scheme.uid: 1-based global fixture id (1-323), permanent, independent of wiring
id_scheme.label: B{board}.{chain_index}, human-facing location on the bus
id_scheme.dmx_start: LED master slot within the board's universe (+1 dir, +2 speed)

power.scheme: per-board power taps (3 per board, ~27 nodes each)
power.note: each board has 3 power taps; each tap <=120W feeds ~27 nodes
power.scope: power only — independent of the data chain

data_bus.topology: one RS-485 chain per board through 2 hop repeaters (1 driver out + 2 repeaters/board)
data_bus.why: hop repeaters regenerate the signal, resetting the 32-unit-load budget; so one continuous chain instead of 3 parallel driver outputs
data_bus.per_board: 1 board driver output + 2 hop repeaters + 1 terminator at the chain end
data_bus.termination: single 120Ω at the last node of each board chain (NOT per hop)

per_stalk: 6 conductors per stalk: 2 power (bus bar) + 4 data (RS-485 in+out)

assignment.scheme: 4 quarter-domes: N/S hemisphere x 2 vertical halves
